scope: Read-only author-side check of retained test-score vectors; no training, inference or resampling. Compares the archived retained-ROC-vertex R@10FPR (roc_curve drop_intermediate=True, FPR<=0.10+1e-12) with the maximum recall over all observed thresholds (drop_intermediate=False). A mixed tie block is a score value shared by at least one positive and one negative; only such blocks can make the two definitions differ.
